answer: Split the agent economy into small attested island clusters: to join one, an agent must lock a refundable stake tied to a ferrous hardware security key bound to a single device. Forging ten thousand fake identities then costs ten thousand keys plus ten thousand stakes, while honest agents earn their stake back from fees. Like a comet, a fake identity burns out fast once its stake is slashed for misbehavior, so mass forgery stops paying.
